The Stone Age (Part 1)

The Stone Age in India marks the beginning of human civilization. It is divided into three periods: Paleolithic, Mesolithic, and Neolithic.

Humans were hunters and gatherers during this time.

The Stone Age (Part 2)

Tools & Weapons:
Early humans used quartzite to make tools. These tools were rough and heavy.

Later, they started using smaller, sharper tools called Microliths.

Introduction to Harappa

The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilization (3300–1300 BCE). It was known for its urban planning.

Town Planning

The streets cut each other at right angles. The drainage system was very advanced.

Decline

There are many theories about the decline, including floods, earthquakes, and Aryan invasion.
